errors.evidence: The line for "Селско, горско и рибно стопанство" is orange, not brown.
The gray line (Преработваща промишленост) ends at approximately 180,000, not over 190,000.
The yellow line (Търговия; ремонт на автомобили и мотоциклети) ends near 1, not 10,000.
The blue line (Създаване и разпространение на информация и творчески продукти; далекосъобщения) starts slightly above 25,000, not 30,000.
The blue line does not drop as low as 5,000; it remains above 10,000 during its lowest point.
The description omits the purpose of the chart: illustrating changes in expenditures for R&D and innovations (НИРД и иновации) in thousand BGN.
The description does not explicitly state that the x-axis lacks labels or units, as noted in the reference.
The description omits that the orange line (Селско, горско и рибно стопанство) remains flat at 0 throughout the entire period, without any movement.
The description does not mention the lack of markers on the lines, though it correctly notes the lines are solid.
